description: Update (replace) tags for a specific Zendesk user. Use when you need to assign or modify tags on a user account for organizing, filtering, or categorizing user data. This action replaces all existing tags on the user with the provided list.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for updating tags on a specific Zendesk user.

tags.description: An array of tag strings to assign to the user. This will replace all existing tags on the user with the provided list. Tags are used to categorize and organize users.
tags.human_parameter_description: A list of tag strings to assign to the user. This replaces any existing tags.
tags.title: Tags

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the user whose tags to update. This is the user ID found in ticket payloads or user search results.
user_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk user whose tags you want to update.
user_id.title: User Id

inputSchema.title: UpdateUsersTagsRequest

name: update_users_tags

UpdateUsersTagsResponse.description: Response containing the updated tags for a Zendesk user.

tags.description: An array of tag strings now assigned to the user. These tags have replaced any previously assigned tags.
tags.title: Tags

UpdateUsersTagsResponse.title: UpdateUsersTagsResponse
